# Blocks rendered in every run, whatever the delta of the version is.
# One block state per line, in /setblock syntax. Blocks the version does not have are skipped.
# The biome strip (tinted blocks and a water pool in every biome) is always added to these.

minecraft:oak_fence[east=true,north=false,south=false,west=true]
minecraft:oak_door[facing=north,half=lower,hinge=left,open=false,powered=false]
minecraft:glass
minecraft:glass_pane[east=true,north=true,south=false,west=false]
